name: Nu Holdings
thesis: Latin America's leading digital bank (Brazil + Mexico + Colombia). Three engines: (1) customer count compounding on network effects + low-CAC acquisition, (2) ARPAC (revenue per active customer) ramping as customers add credit + investment products, (3) operating leverage as cost-to-serve stays near-zero. Bet: 25%+ revenue growth with ROE crossing 30% and durable Brazil profitability funding Mexico/Colombia expansion. STUB regenerated from corrupted source — needs user review.

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
GAAP operating margin negative for 2 consecutive quarters — operating loss.
Gross margin below 20% for 2 consecutive quarters — severe pricing/cost issue.
GAAP net income negative for 2 consecutive quarters — bottom-line loss.
